title: Nvidia boss ends – level 3
paragraphs: Nvidia’s share price dropped sharply after its co-founder and longtime boss, Jensen Huang, suddenly resigned. His decision followed growing pressure and a company investigation into his secret relationship with a woman suspected of spying for China.

Media reports also revealed a second affair with an executive inside Nvidia. To keep the business stable during this difficult change, the company appointed its finance chief as interim CEO to reassure investors and maintain stability during the unexpected leadership change. However, business experts warn that replacing Huang will be very hard, because he led Nvidia for 33 years and had no clear plan for a successor.

Beyond problems inside the company, the scandal raises serious questions about whether Nvidia broke US rules by selling advanced computer chips to China. Experts expect US politicians and police to investigate the company closely. They warn that Nvidia’s weaker influence in Washington could lead to stricter trade limits and increase political tension between the US and China.

words.d: a person with senior managerial responsibility in a business organization
a person who takes over a job, office, or position after someone else leaves
